task:
Review Student 3 (Local Experience and Attraction Recommender) Release 2 cloud deployment evidence for two real runs of cloud-deployment.yml: the baseline run 39741981906 at 851bdd7 and the protected AI run 39893640923 at 4c1e71a (ai, mcp, rag and multi-agent, behind gateway authentication), including the Student 3 lines of their smoke output. The Release 2 brief REQUIRES the baseline to have AI-Mode, MCP, RAG and Multi-Agent disabled, so no AI service in the baseline run is correct, and the AI run is an optional bonus. The Student 3 Multi-Agent workflow on the cloud is waiting for a human decision. Identify missing or failed evidence, in particular the checks listed under Not evidenced (persistence across redeploy, backup and rollback on the VM, live private boundaries), and recommend actions for the human release decision.

Review the supplied evidence using review-cloud-v1.txt. Propose report findings and corrective actions, not source edits. Missing or failed evidence must remain explicit; only a human can make the release decision.

preTest.result: Reviewing supplied context files, not executing tests or deployment. Validate their provenance and results before human finalisation.

humanNotes: Human review (Khushi, Student 3): the loop ACCEPTed a no-change proposal with no recommended actions; its five SUGGESTION findings only restate the digest's Not evidenced list. Its two REQUIRED validation gaps are wrong: baseline run 39741981906 correctly had AI-Mode, MCP, RAG and Multi-Agent disabled (the brief requires it), and AI run 39893640923 printed 'capabilities match the enabled components: ai, mcp, multi-agent, rag'. The plan also named two files that do not exist under student-3/ and omitted the digest and 03-cloud-smoke.txt. Added by the human: (1) persistence across redeploy and backup, restore and rollback are not evidenced on the VM; (2) private-network boundaries and live TLS and header hardening are not verified against the deployed site; (3) the optional cloud AI bonus rests on one successful run (39893640923), preceded by five dispatch failures whose cause is not recorded; (4) the deployed catalogue listed 10 attractions on 2026-10-26 against 12 in the 2026-10-22 baseline check, cause not established, while the smoke test only requires at least ten; (5) the Student 3 cloud workflow wf-20261023T032459Z-f1ad495f was approved by the owner on 2026-10-26 (cloud/13), although the frozen digest, hashed into this record, still says it is awaiting a decision. Run on another machine: qwen2.5-coder:7b implemented and llama3.1:8b reviewed, because llama3.2:3b twice returned an invalid verdict (attempts 11-12); attempts 1-13 produced no record (logs kept).
